questions.question: You just finished a grueling 3-hour lecture at 12:00 NN under the Mintal heat. What is your immediate priority?

choices.choice: Head straight to Ate Ling’s for sizzling sisig, extra rice, and good chismis.
Go to the library to "study" (matulog ra diay).
Head home to change into proper clothes and keep to your strict daily schedule.
Grab a chilled Sting or Lucky Day iced coffee to stay awake.
Text the GC to check if we can skip the afternoon class and go to DGT.

questions.question: How do you prepare for a major exam week during Hell Week?

choices.choice: Heavy carb-loading muna, bawal mag-review nang gutom
Camp out in the coldest, quietest corner of the library all day.
Study early and strictly sleep before curfew—discipline over panic.
Pull an all-nighter the night before the exam.
Study for 15 minutes, get bored, then manifest class suspensions for a night out.

questions.question: Your professor posts at 7:00 AM: 'Class is asynchronous today.' How do you react?

choices.choice: Call the GC. Gala agad
Celebrate at home by doomscrolling for the next 3 hours.
Wala nakita ang post kay tulog pa diay gihapon.
Finish 5 pending backlogs at 3x speed while chugging your second energy drink.
Good morning everyone—NEVER GROW OLD?! Inom / night out na agad!

questions.question: What is your essential item inside your bag right now?

choices.choice: Wallet, Cellphone, Keys. Only things you need tbh.
Notebook, pen, and a water bottle.
An extra pair of long pants or modest clothes (strictly bawal shorts).
At least one emergency unopened Sting or bottle of Lucky Day iced coffee.
A party fit change of clothes or bottle opener for spontaneous plans.

questions.question: How do you get your daily workout or exercise on campus?

choices.choice: Exploring every cafe near campus.
Walking between CHSS, CSM, and DHK for maximum coverage.
Pacing around EBL strictly checking if people are following house rules and curfew.
My heart rate spiking to 180 BPM purely from caffeine intake.
Dancing and jumping non-stop during weekend night outs.

questions.question: What is your official stance on campus romance?

choices.choice: In a committed, monogamous relationship with myself.
Dili na tinuod ang romance, mangamatay raman gihapon ta tanan.
Strictly BAWAL BF/GF! Focus on studies and self-discipline first.
Happily taken na po.
Depends on who I meet at UPub this coming Friday night.

questions.question: It’s 10:00 PM on a Thursday. What are you most likely doing?

choices.choice: Walking around Basak, Mintal with friends trying to find late-night comfort food.
Deep in a PDF reading rabbit hole in a quiet, secluded spot.
In bed with your phone on silent, observing strict sleep hours.
Staring at the ceiling, contemplating the meaning of life.
Getting ready to go absent tomorrow (cuz para asa pud na musulod og klase on a FRIDAY??)

questions.question: What is your absolute worst nightmare on campus?

choices.choice: Ate Ling's being closed or running out of sisig.
The lib being full, noisy, or having warm air conditioning.
Getting caught wearing shorts or breaking dorm curfew.
Running out of caffeine in the middle of a 24-hour cramming session.
A dead weekend with hangouts scheduled.

questions.question: Someone invites you to a spontaneous meetup right after your last class. Your response?

choices.choice: G! Basta may masarap at mabusog na kainan!
Pass muna, wala nang pera.
I have to decline, study muna ako (feeling summa cum laude ampota).
Tara hanap tayo ng lowkey nga cafe.
G agad! Saan ang shot / tambayan tonight?!

questions.question: What is your favorite sound on campus?

choices.choice: The sizzle of a hot sisig plate being served to your table.
Complete air-conditioned silence and pages turning softly.
The quiet click of the gate locking safely on time before curfew.
The sharp pop of opening a cold Sting or Lucky Day bottle.
Loud bass, clanking glasses, and people shouting

questions.question: What is your signature vibe during a 3-hour afternoon lecture?

choices.choice: Daydreaming about sizzling food and planning the post-class meal.
Slouched near the aircon, silently wishing everyone would stop talking.
Sitting upright in proper attire, taking neat, organized notes.
Leg bouncing violently, eyes wide open, typing at 200 WPM from caffeine.
Checking the clock every 2 minutes waiting for the bell so the night can start.

questions.question: How do you handle a crowded, chaotic room on campus?

choices.choice: Patience is a virtue—I'll wait as long as there’s good food at the end!
Immediately turn around and find a deserted floor or quiet corner.
Ensure everyone is queuing orderly and respecting proper decorum.
Get restless, chug your drink faster, and start pacing around.
Look for people you know inside and turn it into a mini social event.

questions.question: What is your primary motivation to pass your subjects?

choices.choice: To celebrate the end of the term with a grand feast and extra rice.
To graduate peacefully and never have to walk under the heat again.
To maintain self-discipline, respect rules, and make my family proud.
To justify the unspeakable amount of caffeine and sleep deprivation endured.
To party during sembreak without any backlogs hanging over my head.

questions.question: Which quote resonates with your soul the most?

choices.choice: Pag vacant kain agad. Bawal mag-study nang gutom.
Silence is good, but strong air conditioning is heaven.
Rules exist for a reason—discipline builds character!
My blood type is cold brew and red energy drinks.
Work hard, party harder. 'Good morning everyone' means 'Inom na!'

questions.question: What is your main goal when entering campus every morning?

choices.choice: Eat good comfort food with the barkada during long breaks.
Secure a quiet, cold spot in the library before everyone else takes it.
Complete my classes cleanly, follow rules, and keep a spotless record.
Survive the day without my heart giving out from caffeine & stress.
Make it through lectures so we can hit the night spots later.
